description.value: The Acorn is a Michelin-recommended, award-winning vegetable-forward locavore restaurant and bar on Vancouver's Main Street, operating a zero-waste kitchen that sources 99% of its ingredients from BC and Western Canada. Cyclists can choose between a multi-course blind tasting menu served family-style or an à la carte menu featuring inventive dishes built around seasonal foraged and farmed produce. The restaurant is also noted by Michelin for its weekend brunch program.
